attributes.gen_ai.tool.call.arguments: "{\"content\":\"#!/usr/bin/env python3\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"Insert deterministic sample data into the orders table.\\n\\nUsage: python3 scripts/insert_sample_data.py\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport sqlite3\\nimport sys\\n\\nDB_PATH = \\\"data/app.db\\\"\\n\\nSAMPLE_ORDERS = [\\n    # (customer_id, amount)\\n    (101, 250.00),\\n    (102, 49.99),\\n    (101, 120.50),\\n    (103, 89.00),\\n    (102, 310.75),\\n]\\n\\n\\ndef insert_sample_data() -> int:\\n    con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)\\n\\n    existing = con.execute(\\\"SELECT count(*) FROM orders\\\").fetchone()[0]\\n    if existing:\\n        print(f\\\"SKIP  orders already contains {existing} rows\\\")\\n        con.close()\\n        return 0\\n\\n    try:\\n        con.executemany(\\n            \\\"INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, amount) VALUES (?, ?)\\\",\\n            SAMPLE_ORDERS,\\n        )\\n        con.commit()\\n    except sqlite3.Error as exc:\\n        con.rollback()\\n        print(f\\\"FAIL  insert error: {exc}\\\", file=sys.stderr)\\n        return 1\\n\\n    count, total = con.execute(\\n        \\\"SELECT count(*), round(sum(amount), 2) FROM orders\\\"\\n    ).fetchone()\\n    print(f\\\"OK    inserted {count} rows, total amount {total}\\\")\\n    for row in con.execute(\\\"SELECT id, customer_id, amount, created_at FROM orders ORDER BY id\\\"):\\n        print(f\\\"      {row}\\\")\\n\\n    con.close()\\n    return 0\\n\\n\\nif __name__ == \\\"__main__\\\":\\n    sys.exit(insert_sample_data())\\n\",\"path\":\"scripts/insert_sample_data.py\"}"
